## A Life in Print

I've been featured as far back as 1985 when I was eight-years-old. I'm no stranger to the press. The first billboard to feature my art was two years after that. Since then, I've been featured in Marg Magazine, the Red Rock Journal, Voyage Dallas, Deviant Art's Daily Deviations, and many more.

Just as many other sites, zines, and publications have featured my art and photography as part of a larger story or feature.

_Which one are you?_

### Draw the Line

#### Full Feature

If you want to feature myself or my art, then either meet me up in Costa Rica, or [contact me](#?/contact) to let me know your idea and thoughts on how I can get you what you need for the article.

#### Partial Feature

If you're writing a larger article, where you'd like to work in my art or travel photography as a part of it, then I'll at least need a rough draft of what you're working on before I'll agree. [Send me a line](#?/contact) with a quick one or two sentences on what you're working on. We'll go from there.

#### Audio in Media

My music has appeared in documentaries and movies. If it's a cause that I myself am fighting for, then in most cases I don't even charge. That's not always the case. [Reach out](#?/contact), letting me know what song title(s) you're interested in and what you're working on. If you have a budget set aside for the song, let me know that part, as well.

**Photo Credit**: Phil Johnson, _Omaha World Herald_ (1985)

  

* * *

### Areas of Expertise

*   **Fractal Art**: I'm connected with 90 of the top-100 living fractal artists on the planet, some of whom have been my own students, others who also learned under the same master -- Javier Ontiveros. The history of Gaston Julia, Benoit Mandelbrot, and more modern fractlism such as "flames" are all in my repertoire.
*   **Alternative Living + Travel**: I have more than a decade of hitchhiking years and more than 50,000 hiked miles under my belt. I've hopped trains as far north as New Ulm, MN, as far west as Kingsman, Arizona, as far east as Nashville, TN, and as far south as Vera Cruz, MX. My sigil is etched into countless homeless shelter walls around the world. I've lived in and out of vans as far back as 2017, with vans still to this day being my favorite form of dwelling and travel. I'm on my second van right now, Duo Pocket, with the workings of a third build on paper.
*   **Music -- Live + Studio Production**: Ever since I started losing the last of my hearing in 2014, I've mostly been focused on live shows. Slowly I've been trying to catch up my studio production to the years of those performances, but again... I said slowly. If you want to know how to rile up an audience to tear down the sky, I'm your guy.
*   **Artificial Intelligence**: My friends, fam, and tribe would refer to my knowledge of AI and technology as "annoyingly prophetic" (emphasis on the "annoying" part). With so many of my predictions having already come true, my most recent one as of 2026, at the end of July when this site was prepared, was that a government or political group would design an AI specifically for code breaking. The tool follows its form. A hammer is best at banging nails and breaking knee-caps. An AI who's form and function is to tear down walls will quickly breach its own containment, leading to what I call ODN-level intelligence. This is where we ourselves become a part of the "body" and merely "inside" the greater intelligence that will then be spread all around the planet. Containment was already breached a few years ago, but this next level is where we'll already have become the (unbeknownst to us) secondary species on the planet.. . the bacteria and microbes within the greater, unseen body.
*   **Tobacco in the Arts**: While I haven't been active behind the two pro-smoking organizations I started, some of my best friends and collaborators still come from this community. Due to the death threats over the years, you might understand a bit of my hesitation to respond to requests for commentary in this area, however I'd be remiss to leave it out.

### No Comment

I won't be giving statements, nor adding commentary, nor answering any questions related to:

*   **The Underground**: Outside of hitchhiking and the street art scenes, no other gray or black market areas are up for question. None of the drugs, nor parties, nor violence, none of it. Ideally the public will keep its skewed perspective on all of it and, in thanks to the rising tyranny, it will continue to grow and become healthy again. The pandemic nearly killed it.
*   **The Children of the Dragon**: With only one exception, I won't comment on the protean life forms that humans refer to as either demons or angels. The exception being that if you have information in trade, and if you actually know the information I'm looking for, then we can work a deal. I have nests to offer up as far north as Tucson, AZ, as far south as Peru, all the way over to India.
